title: Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) Manual for Sustainable Millets Production in India
document_type: Official agricultural research and good agricultural practices manual
geographic_scope: India, with state-specific information including Rajasthan
limitations: Recommendations must be filtered by crop zone and local conditions.
Research findings must not be presented as universal recommendations.
Pesticide and chemical treatment recommendations require current registration and label verification.
Historical MSP figures must not be presented as current prices.
